vanguard.name: Mara
vanguard.title: Vanguard
vanguard.desc: Hit an adjacent unit for 1 and push it 1 tile. Crush walls; topple columns.
vanguard.lore: A harbor keeper who remembers every name on the missing list.

ranger.name: Ivo
ranger.title: Ranger
ranger.desc: Pull a visible unit or movable object 1 tile toward you. No damage.
ranger.lore: A former surveyor who trusts knots more than promises.

gardener.name: Fern
gardener.title: Gardener
gardener.desc: Grow a blocking briar on empty ground within 3 tiles.
gardener.lore: Carries the last seeds of the old city in a tea tin.

engineer.name: Pip
engineer.title: Engineer
engineer.desc: Place a charge within 3 tiles. After enemies act, it deals 2 damage in a cross.
engineer.lore: Can repair anything except the things he says too quickly.

tidecaller.name: Neri
tidecaller.title: Tidecaller
tidecaller.desc: Choose a flow direction. Make or redirect a river segment; heal an ally or extinguish fire.
tidecaller.lore: Learned to read rivers before she learned to read words.

archer.name: Ash
archer.title: Longbow
archer.desc: Fire a straight shot for 2 damage. The first unit or object stops it.
archer.lore: Gave up hunting when the birds stopped returning.

medic.name: Lio
medic.title: Field medic
medic.desc: Restore 2 HP to a crew member within 2 tiles.
medic.lore: Keeps empty beds ready, just in case.

carrier.name: Ada
carrier.title: Transporter
carrier.desc: Pick an adjacent ally, then an empty destination within 3 tiles of you. Carry them there.
carrier.lore: Her cargo license once said furniture. People were always more important.

mawkeeper.name: Bram
mawkeeper.title: Maw tender
mawkeeper.desc: Plant a hungry maw. After the enemy turn it bites every adjacent unit for 1.
mawkeeper.lore: Insists the carnivorous plants are misunderstood.

vinekeeper.name: Tess
vinekeeper.title: Vine weaver
vinekeeper.desc: Grow a vine tree. It roots adjacent enemies for their next turn.
vinekeeper.lore: Makes nets from roots and friendships from patience.

shaman.name: Oru
shaman.title: Hearth shaman
shaman.desc: Place a hearth totem. Nearby allies begin their next turn with 4 move points.
shaman.lore: Keeps the names that the Archive tried to erase.

blight.name: Sen
blight.title: Blight keeper
blight.desc: Place a blight totem. Poison spreads from it into adjacent ground each round.
blight.lore: Studies the difference between a medicine and a dose.

bulldozer.name: Rook
bulldozer.title: Bulldozer
bulldozer.desc: Choose a direction: push a whole occupied line away, farthest first.
bulldozer.lore: Retired from demolition. The city has not accepted his resignation.

witch.name: Vale
witch.title: Witch
witch.desc: Charm an enemy for its next turn. It fights its former allies, then recovers.
witch.lore: Once accused of hearing the city think. She did.

astronomer.name: Edda
astronomer.title: Astronomer
astronomer.desc: Choose rain, frost, wind or storm; change the weather for the whole next round.
astronomer.lore: Has never seen a star she did not draw herself.

digger.name: Dax
digger.title: Channel digger
digger.desc: Cut a 3-cell channel in the chosen direction, clearing wood along the way.
digger.lore: Can hear buried water through the soles of his boots.

geomancer.name: Moss
geomancer.title: Geomancer
geomancer.desc: Raise a stone wall on empty ground. Blocks movement and shots.
geomancer.lore: Builds small shelters for people who say they are fine.

sapper.name: Kit
sapper.title: Sapper
sapper.desc: Destroy an object within 4 tiles. Can open cages and crush enemy nests.
sapper.lore: Reads instruction manuals only after the explosion.

mirror.name: Yara
mirror.title: Mirror dancer
mirror.desc: Exchange positions with any unit within 4 tiles. Both arrivals trigger terrain.
mirror.lore: Remembers a twin that no official record admits existed.

blink.name: Noa
blink.title: Blink runner
blink.desc: Teleport yourself to any empty tile within 4 tiles. Arrival triggers terrain.
blink.lore: Always gets there before she has thought of what to say.

ferryman.name: Keel
ferryman.title: Ferryman
ferryman.desc: Choose a unit standing in water, then another empty river tile. Ferry it there.
ferryman.lore: Does not ask passengers which side they are on.

builder.name: June
builder.title: Bridgewright
builder.desc: Build a bridge across a gap, pit, water or lava tile within 3 tiles.
builder.lore: Her bridges always have room for one more person.

alchemist.name: Iris
alchemist.title: Alchemist
alchemist.desc: Turn dangerous terrain into safe moss and remove harmful objects on that tile.
alchemist.lore: Wants to give the city something that cannot be rationed.

firestarter.name: Cinder
firestarter.title: Firestarter
firestarter.desc: Ignite a tile within 4 tiles. Fire spreads through nearby wood.
firestarter.lore: A warm heart and an unfortunate sense of timing.

warden.name: Holt
warden.title: Warden
warden.desc: Give an ally a shield that absorbs the next damaging hit.
warden.lore: Guarded the wrong door for thirty years. He chooses his doors now.

herder.name: Mina
herder.title: Whisper herder
herder.desc: Attract a unit 2 tiles toward you, one step at a time. No direct damage.
herder.lore: Knows the old machines respond to lullabies.

gust.name: Gale
gust.title: Gust caller
gust.desc: Choose a tile; push every neighboring unit one tile away from it.
gust.lore: Rarely speaks above a whisper. The wind does the rest.

magnet.name: Pol
magnet.title: Magnetist
magnet.desc: Pull every metal object and machine neighboring a chosen tile toward its center.
magnet.lore: Collects lost keys to houses that no longer stand.

courier.name: Wren
courier.title: Courier
courier.desc: Dash yourself up to 5 tiles in a straight line, stopping before blockers. Costs your action.
courier.lore: Has delivered three thousand letters and opened none.

anchorite.name: Ansel
anchorite.title: Anchorite
anchorite.desc: Root a unit in place for its next turn. It cannot move or be pushed.
anchorite.lore: Stood through the flood so others could hold onto him.

tinkerer.name: Mika
tinkerer.title: Tinkerer
tinkerer.desc: Turn a fan, spring, mirror, conveyor or river segment clockwise.
tinkerer.lore: Asks what would happen if everything pointed the other way.

conductor.name: Bea
conductor.title: Conductor
conductor.desc: Activate every lever and console on the map at once.
conductor.lore: Once directed trains; now coordinates strangers.

weaver.name: Loom
weaver.title: Gate weaver
weaver.desc: Choose two empty tiles within 4 tiles to weave a pair of linked portals.
weaver.lore: Follows the loose threads at the edge of the world.

siren.name: Una
siren.title: Siren
siren.desc: Put all enemies adjacent to the target tile to sleep for one enemy turn.
siren.lore: The Archive stored her songs under dangerous materials.

icewright.name: Fenn
icewright.title: Icewright
icewright.desc: Freeze a cross of tiles. Water becomes ice; fires go out; units are rooted for one turn.
icewright.lore: Builds temporary things because permanence frightened his father.

beekeeper.name: Bex
beekeeper.title: Beekeeper
beekeeper.desc: Release a friendly drone on an empty tile. It moves and bites enemies for 3 rounds.
beekeeper.lore: The bees came back to her before any birds came back to Ash.

demolition.name: Boom
demolition.title: Detonator
demolition.desc: Detonate every charge and explosive barrel immediately. Keep your crew clear.
demolition.lore: Has an excellent safety record, depending on how you count buildings.

recaller.name: Remy
recaller.title: Recaller
recaller.desc: Return an ally to its deployment tile. Restores no HP but can rescue it from danger.
recaller.lore: Remembers the way home even when home moves.

scout.name: Sable
scout.title: Scout
scout.desc: Leap to a tile within 5, clearing smoke and thorns in a cross on arrival.
scout.lore: Draws maps of the places everyone else walks past.

liberator.name: Luz
liberator.title: Liberator
liberator.desc: Open a cage or convert a neutral unit into controllable crew from a distance.
liberator.lore: Kept a door open for ten years. Someone finally walked through.

harvester.name: Reed
harvester.title: Harvester
harvester.desc: Cut all wooden objects around a target tile. Every cut heals adjacent crew by 1.
harvester.lore: Can tell what a forest looked like from a single root.

plumber.name: Elin
plumber.title: River turner
plumber.desc: Reverse every river and conveyor direction on the map. Does not move units immediately.
plumber.lore: Finds that most emergencies are pressure looking for somewhere to go.

rainmaker.name: Rin
rainmaker.title: Rainmaker
rainmaker.desc: Rain over a cross: extinguish fire and heal every ally there by 1.
rainmaker.lore: Was paid to promise sunshine. Prefers the truth.

firefighter.name: Faro
firefighter.title: Firefighter
firefighter.desc: Spray a straight line: extinguish flames and push the first unit or movable object.
firefighter.lore: A rescue worker from a city everyone was told had drowned.

mason.name: Slate
mason.title: Stone mover
mason.desc: Select a wall or boulder, then an empty neighboring tile to move it into.
mason.lore: Sees buildings as things that have not finished moving yet.

lantern.name: Lux
lantern.title: Lantern keeper
lantern.desc: Place a lantern. At round end it heals adjacent allies for 1.
lantern.lore: Tends the lamps on a street erased from every map.

spore.name: Myra
spore.title: Spore artist
spore.desc: Spread poisonous ground in a cross. It hurts both sides at round end.
spore.lore: Paints warnings in colors that only the machines can see.

puppeteer.name: Nox
puppeteer.title: Puppeteer
puppeteer.desc: Push a unit or movable object 1 tile in your chosen direction from a distance.
puppeteer.lore: Refused an order for the first time. Has not stopped since.

rigger.name: Rivet
rigger.title: Rigger
rigger.desc: Lay a directional conveyor. It pushes its occupant one tile at every round end.
rigger.lore: Used to build assembly lines. Wants people to get off them.

bombardier.name: Kestrel
bombardier.title: Bombardier
bombardier.desc: Lob a shell over obstacles: 1 damage in a cross, destroying fragile objects.
bombardier.lore: The saboteur who stayed to help rebuild what she broke.

sentinel.name: Sentinel
sentinel.text: Moves 1 tile, then fires for 1 at the first obstacle or unit in a straight line.

brute.name: Breaker
brute.text: Closes in and hits an adjacent target for 1, pushing it away.

gunner.name: Rail gunner
gunner.text: Moves 1 tile and fires a 2-damage straight shot. Cover stops it.

mortar.name: Mortar
mortar.text: Lobs a 1-damage shell within 6 tiles, ignoring cover. Later patrols prioritize vulnerable crew.

webber.name: Silk drone
webber.text: Roots a nearby crew member within 3 tiles, preventing movement next round. Recharges for a turn between webs.

arsonist.name: Cinder drone
arsonist.text: Ignites ground near the nearest crew member. Fire spreads through wood.

sower.name: Iron gardener
sower.text: Plants a blocking vine near the crew, closing routes instead of shooting.

sapper.name: Charge layer
sapper.text: Places a charge near a crew member within 4 tiles. It explodes after the following enemy turn, leaving one player turn to escape or disarm it.

leech.name: Siphon
leech.text: Drains 1 HP from an adjacent unit, healing itself.

healer.name: Repair drone
healer.text: Repairs an injured machine within 3 tiles. Fires only if no repair is needed.

rammer.name: Ram engine
rammer.text: Moves up to 2 tiles, then pushes an adjacent target. Collisions hurt.

mesmer.name: Hush unit
mesmer.text: Silences a crew member within 3 tiles, taking away its next action. Must recharge between uses.

warden.name: Shield bearer
warden.text: Shields another machine nearby. Shields absorb one damaging hit.

drone.name: Leaping drone
drone.text: Leaps over intervening objects, then bites an adjacent crew member.

foundry.name: Foundry
foundry.text: Stationary. Manufactures a sentinel every 3 rounds if there is space.

saboteur.name: Flow saboteur
saboteur.text: Rotates nearby fans and reverses nearby currents before firing.

bellkeeper.name: Bell keeper
bellkeeper.text: Pulls the nearest crew member toward itself, letting terrain do the harm.

frost.name: Frost engine
frost.text: Freezes ground beneath a crew member within 4 tiles and roots it for a turn. Recharges between freezes.

heart.name: Weather Heart
heart.text: Stationary. Fires for 1 in all four directions. Trees and walls intercept shots.

sovereign.name: The Auditor
sovereign.text: Alternates mortar fire and shields. Its defeat releases the district from control.

ground.name: Ground
ground.text: Normal ground. One voluntary step costs 1 point.

water.name: Current
water.text: Follow the arrow to the next river segment, at most 2 cells per entry. After leaving water, stop on the first land tile. The direction may turn at each segment.

ice.name: Ice
ice.text: Entering slides in the entry direction until blocked or off the ice. Sliding is free.

fire.name: Fire
fire.text: 1 damage on entering and at round end. Spreads into adjacent wooden objects or grass. Rain extinguishes it.

goal.name: Objective pad
goal.text: A marked exit, relay or delivery point. Read this mission’s objective for its purpose.

mud.name: Mud
mud.text: Entering costs 2 movement points. Forced movement is not slowed.

poison.name: Poisoned ground
poison.text: Deals 1 damage to its occupant at round end. Cleansing or rain removes it.

conveyor.name: Conveyor
conveyor.text: At round end, pushes its occupant one tile in its arrow direction. Can be rotated.

cracked.name: Cracked floor
cracked.text: Collapses into a pit when a unit voluntarily leaves it. Forced entry is possible; plan your way out.

pit.name: Open pit
pit.text: Cannot be walked onto. A unit pushed into it is disabled. June can bridge it.

lava.name: Lava
lava.text: Deals 2 damage on entering and at round end. Can be bridged or cleansed.

thorns.name: Thorns
thorns.text: Deals 1 damage on entry. Does not hurt units standing still. Can be burned or cleared.

grass.name: Dry grass
grass.text: Safe to walk on. Adjacent fire ignites it at round end.

smoke.name: Smoke
smoke.text: Blocks straight shots and line-of-sight abilities. Walking through it clears it.

mist.name: Deep mist
mist.text: Units inside cannot use ranged abilities beyond 1 tile. Rain or a scout clears it.

charged.name: Charged floor
charged.text: Harmless normally; deals 1 damage to its occupant during storm weather.

quicksand.name: Quicksand
quicksand.text: Roots its occupant at round end, taking away next round’s movement.

moss.name: Restoring moss
moss.text: Heals its occupant by 1 at round end. Helps both teams.

runway.name: Old runway
runway.text: First entry each round grants the unit 1 extra move point. Cannot be farmed by walking back and forth.

snow.name: Deep snow
snow.text: Costs 2 movement points to enter. Fire melts it into normal ground.

springwater.name: Still water
springwater.text: Extinguishes fire on entry and removes root. No current: it does not carry units.

wall.name: Stone wall
wall.text: Blocks movement and shots. Ram, demolition, charges and falling columns destroy it.

tree.name: Briar tree
tree.text: Blocks shots and movement. Burns beside fire. A shot destroys it.

column.name: Column
column.text: Ram topples it along 2 tiles for 2 damage, crushing objects. Shots can shatter it.

crate.name: Wooden crate
crate.text: Can be pushed or grappled. Blocks shots and movement. Burns easily.

seed.name: Seed capsule
seed.text: Walk onto it to collect it. Counts toward collection objectives.

lever.name: Lever
lever.text: Interact from an adjacent tile to open all gates and activate nearby mechanisms.

gate.name: Flood gate
gate.text: Blocks movement and shots until a lever or circuit opens it.

bomb.name: Armed charge
bomb.text: Detonates after the enemy turn: 2 damage in a cross. Both teams can be hurt. Movable.

fan.name: Directional fan
fan.text: At round end pushes units along its arrow direction. Rotation changes that direction.

barrel.name: Explosive barrel
barrel.text: Explodes for 2 damage in a cross when hit. Can be pushed or grappled.

boulder.name: Boulder
boulder.text: A movable stone barrier. Can be pushed, grappled or relocated.

mirror.name: Turning mirror
mirror.text: Reflects straight shots 90° clockwise. Can be rotated to choose the outgoing direction.

spring.name: Launch spring
spring.text: On entry, launches the unit 2 tiles in its arrow direction; collisions stop it.

portal.name: Woven gate
portal.text: Entering transports you to its linked partner if that tile is empty.

bridge.name: Bridge
bridge.text: Makes a gap, pit, river or lava safe to cross; suppresses terrain beneath.

plate.name: Pressure plate
plate.text: Entering opens gates. No action needed.

spikes.name: Spike bed
spikes.text: 1 damage to an occupant at round end. Can be disabled by interaction.

beacon.name: Healing lantern
beacon.text: Heals adjacent crew by 1 at round end. Some missions require protecting it.

vine.name: Binding tree
vine.text: Roots adjacent enemies for their next turn. Also blocks shots and burns.

maw.name: Hungry maw
maw.text: Bites every neighboring unit for 1 at round end, including crew. Blocks shots.

haste.name: Hearth totem
haste.text: Allies within 1 tile begin the next round with 4 move points.

blight.name: Blight totem
blight.text: Turns neighboring ground to poison at round end. Burns like wood.

pump.name: Flow pump
pump.text: Interact to rotate all river directions clockwise.

generator.name: Live generator
generator.text: During storms, damages all neighboring units for 1. Can be demolished.

switch.name: Mechanism switch
switch.text: Interact to turn all fans and conveyors clockwise.

nest.name: Machine nest
nest.text: Spawns a sentinel every 3 rounds if an adjacent tile is free.

cage.name: Rescue cage
cage.text: Interact next to it or break it to free a controllable ally. The mission explains who is inside.

supply.name: Medical cache
supply.text: Collect by stepping onto it: restores 1 HP.

relic.name: Archive fragment
relic.text: Collect by entering. Some missions require carrying a fragment to an exit. Its sealed casing withstands fire and shots.

console.name: Relay console
console.text: Interact next to it to seal or repair it. Sealed consoles become safe ground.

cart.name: Evacuation cart
cart.text: Push or grapple this armored cart onto the gold delivery pad. It stops shots safely, but an explosion can destroy it.

anchor.name: Anchor stone
anchor.text: Prevents forced movement of neighboring units. Can be demolished.

emitter.name: Shield emitter
emitter.text: At round end gives every adjacent unit a one-hit shield. Works for both teams.

glass.name: Thin glass
glass.text: Shatters on entry. The tile remains walkable.

oil.name: Oil cask
oil.text: Ignites its cross when hit or burned. Can be pushed.

bell.name: Signal bell
bell.text: Draws enemy movement toward itself. Ring by interacting to stun adjacent enemies.

rod.name: Lightning rod
rod.text: Intercepts storm damage on itself and keeps adjacent units safe from storms.

drain.name: Drain grate
drain.text: Stops a current on this tile. Occupants leave water here and stop.

sign.name: Field marker
sign.text: Interact to hear an optional clue from the district’s residents.

worker-drone.name: Worker drone
worker-drone.description: Beekeeper summon; distinct friendly honeybee sprite.
